phase_3.identity_trust_design: ADR specifies G2-C-only local identity, canonical fingerprint requirement, explicit out-of-band first-contact trust after key-possession proof, revocation/rotation, encrypted integrity-protected persistence, no plaintext private key fallback, and peer-bound session records. Not implemented beyond raw fingerprint and volatile pin API.
phase_3.flutter_ui: G2-C TEST-ONLY screen is integrated from Diagnostics and uses actual typed MethodChannel/EventChannel: start/stop discovery, real opaque candidate selection/connect, server start/stop, disconnect, truthful errors/capabilities/permissions, and test-frame send only while service-ready. Disposal cancels subscription and disconnects; Activity pause and native EventChannel cancellation also stop operations. No production messaging or authentication/trust UI.
phase_3.runtime_permissions: Operation-scoped: SCAN only for scan (API31+ BLUETOOTH_SCAN; API23-30 ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION; pre23 no runtime permission), CONNECT only for client connection (API31+), CONNECT+ADVERTISE for server (API31+). Legacy Bluetooth permissions are manifest install-time through API30. Denial blocks operation; requestable/permanent denial and settings are exposed. Permission state refresh re-checks grants; radio status unknown without API31+ CONNECT rather than requesting extra permission. Not device-validated.
phase_3.transport_source_review: Inspected existing GATT/fragment lifecycle and retained bounded queues; corrected variable fragment-size reassembly to accommodate MTU changes safely, stale scan callback acceptance, server callback device matching, send/notification timeout and lifecycle permission/foreground handling. No runtime validation.
phase_3.bluetooth_capability_status: Typed Flutter status now includes BLE hardware and Bluetooth radio enabled; radio state is true/false only when Android permits inspection, otherwise null/unknown. Missing scanner is reported as bluetooth_unavailable, not unsupported hardware.
phase_3.server_callback_source_audit: Duplicate current-peer connection and service-added events ignored; notification advancement requires matching pending index. Residual cross-lifecycle late callback attribution risk remains; not runtime-validated.

transport_features.gatt_client: Source present: API-27-compatible explicit connect, UUID service/CCCD checks, service readiness, MTU default fallback, writes/notifications and cleanup.
transport_features.gatt_server: Source present: service registration, explicit UUID advertising, one-peer policy, CCCD subscription, bounded receive and notify.
transport_features.discovery: Source present: explicit foreground G2-C UUID scan, 20-second deadline, up to 32 opaque candidates; peer addresses/names never sent to Dart.
transport_features.framing: Version 1 validation only: 512-byte payload max, 516-byte full frame max.
transport_features.fragmentation: MTU-3 ATT capacity clamped 20..514, 9-byte fragment header, 2048-byte message max, 192 fragment max, one in-flight assembly and 15-second timeout.
transport_features.production_messaging: No integration; decoded test frames discarded.

security_decisions: No authenticated protocol implementation or dependency selection; authenticated state remains unreachable and Dart rejects authenticated=true.
Discovery, connection, service readiness, trust, and authentication are separate concepts; no automatic trust.
BLE transport encryption is not E2E security.
No production identity/key reuse, packet format, production messaging, routing, simulator, or golden vector changes.
Do not write private keys in plaintext; Android Keystore per-algorithm/API27 support must be verified; no silent fallback.
not_implemented_or_blocked: Protocol/library implementation and authenticated key agreement
Transcript-bound mutual authentication, session keys, replay defense, rekey/expiry, secure teardown
Persistent Keystore-backed local identity and protected trusted peer records
Compilation, tests, device acceptance, independent security review
